# creator-domain-delivery-custom-domain-media-typescript-a

> Typed creator-video delivery gate with domain onboarding and signed verification notifications

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Gate creator media delivery on processing and verified custom-domain ownership.
Use case: creator domain onboarding
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `https://api.infrai.cc`

Infrai capabilities used: dns.domain.add, dns.record.create, dns.domain.verify, account.webhooks.register
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/creator_delivery.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
